learner_operation: Determine an axis intercept of a tangent or normal to an implicitly defined curve.

fixed_features.feature: Easy uses positive diagonal quadratics with radio pairs.
fixed_features.justification: Manageable source-supported tangent task, with full derivative and intercept reasoning retained; moderate/hard family and response rules unchanged.

answer_roles.role: Axis, point signs, family, tangent/normal and answer position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Both axes and signed coordinates; tangent easy/moderate, normal hard.
answer_roles.observed: Independent math records contain the actual selected families, axes, point signs and keyed results.

coverage.case: Final five per band and twelve supplementary cases per band
coverage.result: 51 prompts have no added procedural hints; independent derivatives/intercepts and displayed solutions agree.

counterfactuals.change: Change requested axis on same implicit curve/contact point.
counterfactuals.observed: Both keyed points independently derived and distinct.

counterfactuals.justification: Nonzero equation scaling preserves the locus and derivative ratio.
